description: Review React data-layer code against react-server-state (and react-data-grid when table code is in scope)

divergence.preamble: This plugin ships TWO skills. If the scope touches TanStack Table or Virtual code (`useReactTable`, `useTable`, `createColumnHelper`, `getCoreRowModel`, `tableFeatures`, `useVirtualizer`, `manualPagination`, a shadcn DataTable), ALSO invoke the `react-data-grid` skill and pin its findings to the installed `@tanstack/react-table` major from the lockfile — v8 (`useReactTable` + `getCoreRowModel`) and v9 (`useTable` + `tableFeatures()`) APIs must never be mixed in one finding. Pin `react-server-state` findings to the installed query library (`@tanstack/react-query`, `swr`, or RTK Query) rather than assuming one.
